mindset: Why does this matter to me?
Is this driven by fear, ambition, responsibility, curiosity or meaning?
Is this aligned with my long-term direction?
growth: What changed in me after learning this?
Where did I apply it last month?
What would I do differently now?

nodes.name: SELF
nodes.subtitle: Benson
nodes.description: The root of the whole system. Every branch is a part of life; none of them alone defines SELF.
nodes.why: Keeps work, money, family, learning, health and inner life in one view so trade-offs stay visible.
nodes.notes: Hierarchy = structure. Focus = attention. Links = relationships. Timeline = direction. Status = reality. Progress = movement. Notes = reflection.

nodes.name: Career & Work
nodes.description: Current professional role and the capabilities built through it.
nodes.why: Main source of income, identity at work and the platform for future roles.

nodes.name: Danfoss
nodes.description: Danfoss Climate Solutions, Data Center Solutions, Taiwan. Sales Manager.
nodes.why: Current employer and the base for internal growth options.

nodes.name: Data Center
nodes.description: AI and cloud data center thermal management market.
nodes.why: Fast-growing market where domain depth creates long-term value.

nodes.name: Liquid Cooling
nodes.description: Liquid cooling solutions for high-density AI racks: cooling distribution, heat transfer, control and sensing.
nodes.why: Core technical domain. Links sales work to research and Digital Twin work.

nodes.name: CDU
nodes.description: Coolant Distribution Units: pumps, heat exchanger, controls, filtration.
nodes.why: System-level product where component knowledge comes together.

nodes.name: Control & Solenoid Valves
nodes.description: Flow control, isolation and safety valves in secondary loops.
nodes.why: Component content per rack and per CDU.

nodes.name: Sensors
nodes.description: Pressure, temperature and flow sensing for monitoring and control.
nodes.why: Sensors feed telemetry, which is the base of a live Digital Twin.

nodes.name: Plate Heat Exchangers
nodes.description: BPHE / MPHE for liquid-to-liquid heat transfer.
nodes.why: Key thermal component in CDU design.

nodes.name: Sales
nodes.description: Revenue ownership, forecasting, pricing, quotation and order flow.
nodes.why: Execution base that funds credibility for bigger roles.

nodes.name: Business Development
nodes.description: New accounts, new applications and new market segments.
nodes.why: Moves the role from execution to growth.

nodes.name: Technical Sales
nodes.description: Requirement → evidence → assessment → risk → next step. Bridge between customer engineering and product teams.
nodes.why: Differentiator versus pure commercial sales.

nodes.name: Customer Strategy
nodes.description: Account plans, stakeholder maps and solution positioning.
nodes.why: Decides where time and resources go.

nodes.name: Key Accounts
nodes.description: Server ODM, thermal module and system integrator accounts. Named accounts live in private-data.json only.
nodes.why: Concentrated revenue and the main design-in opportunities.
nodes.notes: Public version keeps this generic on purpose. Add named accounts as private nodes.

nodes.name: Data Center Ecosystem
nodes.description: Hyperscalers, ODMs, thermal suppliers, integrators, standards bodies (OCP).
nodes.why: Seeing the whole value chain shows where influence is decided.

nodes.name: Leadership at Work
nodes.description: Leading without full authority: cross-functional alignment, influence, ownership.
nodes.why: Required step toward senior and regional roles.

nodes.name: Internal Career
nodes.description: Growth options inside the current company: scope, title, regional or technical roles.
nodes.why: Lowest-risk path to more scope if the opportunity is real.

nodes.name: External Career
nodes.description: Options outside the current company. Kept generic in the public version.
nodes.why: Market reference point for value and scope.

nodes.name: Future & Vision
nodes.description: Where the next 3–5 years should lead: scope, role type, location, financial position.
nodes.why: Direction turns daily effort into compound progress.

nodes.description: Degree completion, stronger savings phase, first career-transition window.
nodes.why: First milestone year where several branches converge.

nodes.description: Senior / regional / international role development.
nodes.why: Converts 2027 capabilities into scope.

nodes.description: Executive scope, research commercialization, financial flexibility.
nodes.why: Long-range anchor. Reviewed yearly, not fixed.

nodes.name: Overseas / International Role
nodes.description: Regional or international role with global scope.
nodes.why: International exposure and strategic authority.

nodes.name: Taiwan Executive Role
nodes.description: Country or business-unit leadership in Taiwan.
nodes.why: Senior scope without relocation.

nodes.name: VP Path
nodes.description: Capabilities needed: P&L view, team leadership, strategy, executive presence.
nodes.why: Long-term leadership track.

nodes.name: Digital Twin / Software Career
nodes.description: Roles combining data center domain knowledge with Digital Twin and software skills.
nodes.why: Rare combination: domain + software + customer-facing.

nodes.name: Data Center Expert
nodes.description: Recognized expert in AI data center thermal management.
nodes.why: Expertise compounds across any of the role paths.

nodes.name: Personal Legacy
nodes.description: What should remain: work, knowledge shared, family, character.
nodes.why: Keeps short-term ambition in proportion.

nodes.name: Finance
nodes.description: High-level personal finance. Exact figures only in private-data.json.
nodes.why: Financial stability supports family security and career freedom.
nodes.notes: Phase 1: debt reduction. Phase 2 (from ~2027): increase savings and asset accumulation. Phase 3: more financial flexibility, less dependency on salary.

nodes.name: Income
nodes.description: All income sources.
nodes.why: Defines the capacity for every other finance goal.

nodes.name: Salary
nodes.description: Base compensation.
nodes.why: Stable base for fixed obligations.

nodes.name: Bonus
nodes.description: Variable compensation.
nodes.why: Use for debt reduction and savings, not lifestyle creep.

nodes.name: Debt Reduction
nodes.description: Phase 1 of the financial plan.
nodes.why: Lower debt = lower fixed cost = more freedom of choice.
nodes.nextAction: Review repayment order and monthly plan.

nodes.name: Mortgage
nodes.description: Home loan. Balance and rate in private data only.
nodes.why: Largest long-term obligation.

nodes.name: Personal Loan
nodes.description: Balance and rate in private data only.
nodes.why: Typically higher rate. First repayment candidate.

nodes.name: Savings
nodes.description: Phase 2 focus from ~2027.
nodes.why: Builds options and resilience.

nodes.name: Emergency Fund
nodes.description: Months of fixed expenses held in cash.
nodes.why: Protects the family from income shocks.

nodes.name: Investment & Assets
nodes.description: Long-term assets after debt and emergency fund are in place.
nodes.why: Reduces dependency on salary over time.

nodes.name: Retirement
nodes.description: Long-horizon retirement planning.
nodes.why: Small early decisions compound.

nodes.name: Insurance
nodes.description: Protection for health, life and assets.
nodes.why: Downside protection for the family.

nodes.name: Cash Flow
nodes.description: Monthly in / out and surplus.
nodes.why: The single best leading indicator of financial health.

nodes.name: Financial Freedom
nodes.description: Phase 3: income options beyond salary.
nodes.why: Freedom to choose roles on meaning and growth, not only pay.

nodes.name: Family
nodes.description: Career success is not evaluated independently from family quality.
nodes.why: The reason behind much of the effort, and a constraint to respect.

nodes.name: Partner
nodes.description: Relationship with spouse.
nodes.why: Main partner in life decisions.

nodes.name: Children
nodes.description: Children's growth, education and time together. No personal details in public data.
nodes.why: Future planning has to include their timeline.

nodes.name: Parents
nodes.description: Care and time for parents.
nodes.why: Time-limited. Easy to postpone, hard to recover.

nodes.name: Family Time
nodes.description: Protected, regular time with family.
nodes.why: The first thing work erodes.
nodes.nextAction: Block family time in the calendar first.

nodes.name: Responsibility
nodes.description: Roles and duties inside the family.
nodes.why: Shared clarity reduces friction.

nodes.name: Financial Security
nodes.description: Family protected against income and health shocks.
nodes.why: Link between finance and family.

nodes.name: Family Travel
nodes.description: Trips and shared experiences.
nodes.why: Shared memories; also recovery.

nodes.name: Family Communication
nodes.description: How decisions and concerns are discussed at home.
nodes.why: Big career moves need family alignment first.

nodes.name: Long-Term Family Planning
nodes.description: Housing, schooling, location and care over the next 5–10 years.
nodes.why: Any overseas or major role change is a family decision.

nodes.name: Psychology & Mindset
nodes.description: Self-reflection, decision quality, leadership and emotional awareness. Not a clinical tool.
nodes.why: Decision quality depends on the state of the person making the decision.

nodes.name: Self Awareness
nodes.description: Seeing own patterns, triggers and motives clearly.
nodes.why: Base for every other mindset node.

nodes.name: Strengths
nodes.description: Technical sales depth, customer trust, cross-domain learning, execution.
nodes.why: Build roles around strengths.
prompts: Where did my strengths create results this month?

nodes.name: Weaknesses
nodes.description: Areas that limit results today.
nodes.why: Know which ones matter for the next role.
prompts: Which weakness actually costs me results?
Is it a skill gap or a habit?

nodes.name: Blind Spots
nodes.description: What others see that I do not.
nodes.why: Usually the highest-value feedback.
prompts: What feedback did I dismiss recently?
Who could tell me the truth about this?

nodes.name: Emotion
nodes.description: Noticing emotional state before decisions.
nodes.why: Emotion is data, not a decision.

nodes.name: Confidence
nodes.description: Calibrated self-belief — neither over- nor under-confident.
nodes.why: Calibration beats encouragement.

nodes.name: Ego
nodes.description: Need to be right, recognized or in control.
nodes.why: Ego distorts judgment and negotiation.

nodes.name: Decision Making
nodes.description: Separating fact, inference, interpretation and recommendation.
nodes.why: Quality of life = quality of decisions over time.

nodes.name: Power
nodes.description: Understanding authority, influence and organizational dynamics.
nodes.why: Needed for senior roles; easy to misuse.

nodes.name: Leadership Mindset
nodes.description: Ownership, clarity and care for the team.
nodes.why: Leadership starts inside before it shows outside.

nodes.name: Communication
nodes.description: Clear, short, honest communication.
nodes.why: Credibility is built in every message.

nodes.name: Discipline
nodes.description: Doing the important thing when motivation is low.
nodes.why: Turns plans into progress.

nodes.name: Focus
nodes.description: Where attention actually goes, versus where it should go.
nodes.why: Attention is the scarcest resource.

nodes.name: Stress
nodes.description: Load, pressure and recovery balance.
nodes.why: Chronic stress lowers judgment and health.

nodes.name: Resilience
nodes.description: Recovering from setbacks without losing direction.
nodes.why: Long careers are built on recovery speed.

nodes.name: Reflection
nodes.description: Regular review of actions, motives and results.
nodes.why: Experience only becomes learning after reflection.

nodes.name: Meaning
nodes.description: Why the effort matters.
nodes.why: Meaning sustains effort when rewards are delayed.

nodes.name: Values
nodes.description: Principles used to decide when options conflict.
nodes.why: Values settle trade-offs that data cannot.

nodes.name: Identity
nodes.description: Who I am beyond role and title.
nodes.why: Prevents a job change from becoming an identity crisis.

nodes.name: Learning & Education
nodes.description: Learning connected to real career outcomes, not only degrees.
nodes.why: Learning → capability → opportunity.
nodes.notes: Example chain: Learning → Digital Twin → software capability → internal opportunity → international opportunity.

nodes.description: Control design and simulation.
nodes.why: Control logic validation.

nodes.description: Literature review, method, validation, academic writing.
nodes.why: Needed for thesis, journal and patent work.

nodes.name: Research & Digital Twin
nodes.description: AI server data center liquid cooling and Digital Twin development.
nodes.why: Connects research, software, the current industry role and future career options.

nodes.name: Digital Twin
nodes.description: Digital Twin for liquid-cooled AI data centers: live telemetry, models, alarms and control.
nodes.why: Connects research, software development and future career opportunities.
nodes.nextAction: Continue validation and strengthen software architecture.

nodes.name: Data Center Liquid Cooling
nodes.description: Physical system being twinned: racks, CDU, secondary loop, facility water.
nodes.why: Domain knowledge is the twin's moat.

nodes.name: OCP Deschutes
nodes.description: OCP Project Deschutes CDU specification as the reference architecture.

nodes.name: Telemetry
nodes.description: Sensor data ingestion (e.g. Modbus gateway).
nodes.why: No data, no twin.

nodes.name: Trends

nodes.name: Alarm

nodes.name: Control

nodes.name: Hydraulic Model

nodes.name: Equipment Model
nodes.description: Component models: CDU, pumps, valves, sensors.

nodes.name: Validation
nodes.description: Comparing model results with reference or measured data.

nodes.why: External validation and visibility.
